Media producer and wedding planner based in Chennai. Over ten thousand weddings captured, plus custom albums, brand shoots and film work.

About

Based in Chennai, India, Deena is a 27-year-old entrepreneur and visual storyteller with over a decade of experience in media production. As the founder of ADP Studio, he has captured over ten thousand weddings and specializes in custom, high-end photo albums for a global clientele.

Beyond events, Deena works as a strategic YouTube channel manager for creators across six countries. He also brings technical experience from model shoots and feature film production, having worked on eleven films as an assistant cameraman.

Brands worked with: Poorvika, Royal Woods, VGP, Queens Land, Aditya Builders, Casa Grand and Chennai Mobiles.
